title: Add alpha release bundle scaffold
summary: The alpha release contract defines evidence bundles, but operators still have to create the directory and notes by hand. Add a small non-publishing scaffold command that creates a release evidence bundle with generated evidence, a validation notes template, and a dry-run path.
expectedFailureModes: Operators generate evidence JSON but forget validation notes or release decisions.
Release bundle ids include unsafe path traversal or machine-local names.
The scaffold overwrites prior release evidence without an explicit operator decision.
nextAction: Create an alpha release bundle scaffold command, update release docs and landing docs to point at it, and verify the dry-run path.
